records.text: Crain & Company left The Daily Wire voluntarily and now operates as Crain & Cone; it was not shut down by The Daily Wire.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I said yesterday that Crain & Company, the sports company, was shut down at the Daily Wire as another indication. Actually, I learned thereafter that Crain & Company opted to leave on their own, and now they are Crain & Cone, so they left, probably saw the ship going down slowly, and made the decision to leave on their own. So I just always wanted to strive to be accurate. So I was incorrect when I said that yesterday.

verification.notes: The Daily Wire itself described the move as an amicable new chapter, quoted the hosts expressing gratitude and no anger or bitterness, and said the renamed Crain and Cone had joined On3. On3 independently lists the current show. This supports a voluntary move rather than a shutdown.

sources.title: An Exciting New Chapter For Crain and Company
sources.relevance: Primary former-network account confirms the amicable move, renaming, and new On3 home.
